mechanism.name: model_free_public_xor_parallelogram_closure
mechanism.explanation: Build seven XOR-affine closure witnesses solely from precommitted public query positions 24=zero input, 25..40=single-bit basis input, 41..47=seven paired basis-input queries; these positions are supplied in the 24 extra balanced-basis public responses. For each triple, test whether R(e_j XOR e_(j+5)) XOR R(e_j) XOR R(e_(j+5)) XOR R(0) is all-zero as a 16-bit public equality. This is independent of the learned affine or Feistel inverse, its key, graph labels, or hidden source class. Noise in six public answers can break closure; use frozen broad thresholds with explicit witness counts. For matched random query support no guaranteed closure certificate; abstain from the new veto, not invent unsupported witnesses. Original jointly fitted model still uses exactly the same 48 public responses.
mechanism.confounding_disclosure: A public XOR-affine closure statistic is an affine-family structural prior, not universal operator-independent cognition. It must be evaluated as a source-blind observable and cannot be given the evaluator's operator labels or inverse.

prospective_admission.FIT: Select at most one new closure model based only on 24 fresh FIT pairs if and only if it corrects >=1 false-positive case of matched original joint model, itself produces FP0, retains EVERY matched original joint positive case ID and EVERY matched affine positive case ID, gets >=1 correct Feistel pair and strictly more paired correct than strongest 48-public-response affine control. Rank by total paired descending then additional model CPU ascending then arm name ascending. If no model qualifies, no DEV.
prospective_admission.SCREEN: On 24 separate held TRAIN-SCREEN pairs the one FIT-selected new closure model must independently meet every FIT condition with original unchanged source and thresholds. SCREEN cannot elect another model, change thresholds or be used as tuning evidence.
prospective_admission.DEV: No DEV construction/consumption on F124-BC. Separate protected first-use gate only if full FIT and SCREEN conditions both pass.
